title: A finite coefficient vanishing criterion for weight-two Gamma0 cusp forms
statement: For every natural number M ≠ 0, put d = [SL₂(ℤ) : Γ₀(M)] and b = ⌊2d/12⌋. If f is a weight-two cusp form for Γ₀(M) and every period-one q-expansion coefficient of f at a degree n ≤ b is zero, then f = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] (f : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) 2), (∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ (2 * (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M).index) / 12 → (UpperHalfPlane.qExpansion 1 f).coeff n = 0) → f = 0
